tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You have recently joined a university sports club and participated in your first training session. While you enjoyed the session, you found some challenges and would like some advice on how to improve. You need to contact the club coach, Mr. Davis, to ask for guidance. Write an email to Mr. Davis.
bullets: Mention what you enjoyed about the training session.
Ask for advice on how to improve your performance.
tasks.subject: Request for Training Advice
